title.en: SAMPLE: A lab measures a protein that an AI had predicted
title.zh: SAMPLE：實驗室測量了 AI 先前預測的蛋白質

found.en: A second lab measured the shape of a protein complex and found that an AI model had predicted it correctly.
found.zh: 第二間實驗室測量了一個蛋白質複合體的形狀，發現 AI 模型先前的預測是正確的。

matters.en: A protein's shape shows how it works and how a drug might fit. Measuring a shape is slow.
matters.zh: 蛋白質的形狀，顯示它如何運作，以及藥物可能如何契合。測量形狀很費時。

ai_helped.en: Halden Research built the model, Halden Fold. It posted its prediction before anyone had measured the complex.
ai_helped.zh: Halden Research 開發了這個模型 Halden Fold。它在還沒有人測量這個複合體之前，就公布了預測結果。

how_sure.en: Confirmed. PNAS published the measured structure, which matches the prediction in every chain. Halden Research did not do the measurement.
how_sure.zh: 已證實。PNAS 發表了測量得到的結構，與預測在每一條鏈上都相符。測量不是 Halden Research 做的。

background.en: The lab used cryo-electron microscopy, which images frozen molecules, to measure the complex. A first safety trial of a drug that binds the complex is registered as NCT09999002.
background.zh: 實驗室用冷凍電子顯微鏡（cryo-electron microscopy）測量這個複合體，這種技術替冷凍分子成像。一種能與這個複合體結合的藥物，第一項安全性試驗的登記編號為 NCT09999002。

could_lead.en: If more predictions match, AI could shorten the search for new medicines.
could_lead.zh: 如果有更多預測相符，AI 可能縮短尋找新藥的過程。

evidence.quote: Halden Fold predicted the structure of the complex before any measurement
The measured structure matches the model prediction in every chain

note.en: A second lab measured the structure and found the prediction correct.
note.zh: 第二間實驗室測量了結構，發現預測是正確的。
